scope: Diagnostic float32 linear solves on unchanged float64 trajectory and impulse storage rounding, not a full float32 solver or GPU execution.
protocol: Audit the existing successful shared-budget float64 trajectory, without changing any decisions or budgets. At every dense Newton solve, separately cast the scaled Jacobian and RHS to float32 and solve in float32. Evaluate that direction against the original float64 linear equation. Require finite direction and normalized linear residual <=1e-5 for a direct float32-port screen. Count loss of strict interior when accepted float64 states are rounded to float32. At each final solution, round impulses only and apply unchanged original natural/domain and reconstructed wave gates. These are necessary-condition diagnostics, not a float32 algorithm or GPU qualification. Preserve all failures; no scaling, precision, regularization or budget tuning in this experiment.

sources.audit.py:
from pathlib import Path
import json,numpy as np
p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent
source=(p.parent/'rain-interior-global-budget/run.py').read_text()
# Replay the unchanged float64 path; diagnostic solve never feeds its decisions.
source=source.replace("p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;", "p=Path(__file__).resolve().parent;")
source=source.replace('results={}','results={};audit=[];rounding=[]')
source=source.replace('solves+=1;linear=', '''A=D[np.ix_(active,active)];rhs=-F[active]
   try:
    d32=np.linalg.solve(A.astype(np.float32),rhs.astype(np.float32)).astype(np.float64)
    error=float(max(abs(A@d32-rhs)/(1+abs(rhs))))
    item=dict(arm=name,mu=mu,step=step,residual=error,finite=bool(np.all(np.isfinite(d32))),pass_screen=bool(np.all(np.isfinite(d32)) and error<=1e-5))
   except np.linalg.LinAlgError:item=dict(arm=name,mu=mu,step=step,pass_screen=False,singular=True)
   audit.append(item)
   solves+=1;linear=''')
source=source.replace('y=trial;full=', "y=trial;rounding.append(dict(arm=name,mu=mu,step=step,strict_interior=interior(y.astype(np.float32).astype(np.float64))));full=")
source=source.replace("if not all(x['status']=='reference-pass'", "(p/'linear-audit.json').write_text(json.dumps(dict(directions=audit,rounded_accepted_states=rounding),indent=2))\nif not all(x['status']=='reference-pass'")
(p/'replay.py').write_text(source)
exec(compile(source,str(p/'replay.py'),'exec'))
